item.title: Odate Magewappa: Bend Fragrant Cedar into a Lunchbox — Guide
item.description: Magewappa is Odate’s centuries-old bentwood craft — thin sheets of fragrant Akita cedar are steamed, bent into rounded shapes, and secured with cherry-bark strips to make lunchboxes (bento), rice containers and cups renowned for keeping rice at the perfect temperature and humidity. Workshops in Odate let you try bending and finishing your own piece with a local maker. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Odate, Akita Hours By reservation Admission Workshop ~¥2,500 Time needed About 1.
